items.title: DOH readies hospitals for El Niño patient surge
items.description: In anticipation of an influx of patients due to an intensified El Niño, the Department of Health is preparing to temporarily assign hospital personnel from other departments to provide medical attention to patients suffering from heat-related illnesses.

items.title: Lacson hits minority senators for unfair vote in Tulfo case
items.description: Sen. Panfilo Lacson described as unfair the move of three minority senators who opposed the Senate Electoral Tribunal’s ruling that dismissed the quo warranto petition against Lacson’s fellow majority member Sen. Erwin Tulfo.

items.title: ‘VP could still be convicted outside impeachment’
items.description: The evidence uncovered on Vice President Sara Duterte’s alleged misuse of confidential funds could still lead to her criminal conviction, according to House prosecution panel spokesman Rep. Zia Alonto Adiong.

items.title: Infrastructure funds eyed for additional education budget
items.description: The Senate is looking to strip funding from controversial infrastructure projects to finance the Department of Education request for an additional P149.67 billion, including P15.6 billion for a remedial learning program that remains without a dedicated budget.

items.title: Survey: Dissatisfaction with government deepens
items.description: Filipinos dissatisfied with the way the government handles different issues have increased over the past year, a survey conducted by Pulse Asia showed.

items.title: 2nd-hand aircon demand heats up ahead of El Niño
items.description: As the country braces for a super El Niño, more than 115,000 people belong to a Facebook group where users buy second-hand air conditioners at significantly lower prices than new units, despite concerns over higher electricity costs, maintenance expenses and potential safety risks.

items.title: ICC prosecutor wants 5 more testimonies admitted
items.description: An International Criminal Court deputy prosecutor has requested five more prior recorded testimonies of witnesses to be admitted in the crimes against humanity case against former president Rodrigo Duterte.

items.title: First female PMA Commandant of Cadets named
items.description: The Philippine Military Academy named Col. Leah Lorenzo Santiago its first woman Commandant of Cadets, breaking another barrier for women in the military.

items.title: DILG wants tighter airport cargo checks
items.description: Security measures in the country’s airports have been tightened, and intelligence-driven operations against drug syndicates have intensified in the wake of a foiled shipment of 521 kilos of suspected shabu, valued at P3.5 billion, from Laos into the country.

items.title: Sara denies owning fastfood franchise
items.description: Vice President Sara Duterte denied owning a popular fastfood restaurant following the testimony of a prosecution witness that a company listed in her statement of assets, liabilities and net worth owns at least five franchises in Davao City.

items.title: Rappler’s Gelo Gonzales named 2026 East-West Center Jefferson Fellow
items.description: The three-week fellowship will bring journalists to Honolulu, Tokyo, and Seoul to examine artificial intelligence’s impact on societies and economic security in the Asia-Pacific region

items.title: Filipino composer Rom Dongeto and the song we thought we knew
items.description: Decades after a TV commercial propelled it into the mainstream, the activist-born anthem ‘Kanlungan’ — popularized by the voice of Noel Cabangon — continues to transcend generations as a bittersweet classic, though few realize it was composed by Rom Dongeto

items.title: As Asia grays, can an aging Philippines avoid its neighbors’ fate?
items.description: As the share of older Filipinos grows and fewer babies are born, the urgency to prepare rises

items.title: Why every audience vote matters in PETA’s ‘Gen G’ play
items.description: The choose-your-own-adventure format of ‘Gen G’ forces the audience to stay fully immersed in the story, with the active, live-voting feature directly dictating the fate of the characters

items.title: Trend Intel: Chinese microdramas have Filipinos in a chokehold – are you watching?
items.description: What drives Filipinos’ consumption of these bite-sized and often emotionally exaggerated shows?

items.title: The week in photos: October 10-16, 2026
items.description: A recap of news, sports, lifestyle, entertainment, and human interest images from the Philippines and around the globe

items.title: 5 Supreme Court justices vie to become next chief justice
items.description: The candidates include two of the most senior justices: Senior Associate Justice Marvic Leonen and Associate Justice Alfredo Benjamin Caguioa

items.title: Amar’e Stoudemire goes from Miami Heat to Miami police officer
items.description: A six-time NBA All-Star, Amar'e Stoudemire fulfills a ‘childhood dream’ to serve in law enforcement

items.title: Inside story: Politician behind 521-kilo shabu shipment bound for Manila
items.description: DILG chief Remulla says that a former member of the Bangsamoro Transition Authority is allegedly involved in the multi-million-peso shabu mess

items.title: [Rear View] The night they asked Pete Lacaba to sing, and the song that made him cry
items.description: The night ended with a rare request. Pete was asked to sing.
